issues.title: Missing Cross-Language Parent Reference
issues.why: AC-SD-01 and AC-SD-02 explicitly inherit from a 'cross-language parent' (AC-CL-*) located at `../02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/97-acceptance-criteria.md`, but this file is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the 02-coding-guidelines module in the context or inline the specific AC-CL rules referenced.

issues.title: Incomplete Concurrency Implementation in Examples
issues.why: While AC-SD-22 mandates a retry-loop for SQLITE_BUSY, the provided Go implementation of DbManager (01-fundamentals.md) lacks this logic, potentially misleading a mediocre coder.
issues.fix: Update the DbManager.GetOrCreateDb code snippet in 01-fundamentals.md to include the WithRetry wrapper defined in AC-SD-22.

issues.title: Ambiguous Sequence Number Assignment
issues.why: AC-SD-05 requires sequence numbers to be assigned by the Root DB registry but doesn't specify if this is a global counter or per-category/project counter.
issues.fix: Explicitly state in AC-SD-05 that sequence numbers are derived from the 'Counter' table defined in the Root DB schema.
